description.en: A fossil infructescence carries radial fruits built from multiple wedge-like fruitlets.
description.zh: 化石果序带由多枚楔状小果组成的放射果体。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Nordenskioldia borealis, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Nordenskioldia borealis 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Wheel-like fruitlet rings on an axis differ from single winged fruits and clustered elongated follicles.
distinctness.zh: 轴上的轮状小果环区别于单翅果及成簇长蓇葖。

modeling_brief.en: Use a slender branch and a few radial segmented fruits; keep fruitlet boundaries visible without modeling seeds separately.
modeling_brief.zh: 使用细枝和少量放射分段果，使小果边界清晰，不另做种子资产。

uncertainty: Associated Zizyphoides foliage belongs to this concept and is excluded from separate counting.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
